zodiac_years_rule: The BaZi year pillar changes at the Li Chun moment: from the Li Chun listed in a row until the next Li Chun, the year branch is {glyph}, the {name}. Chinese New Year changes the animal on the first day of the lunar year, so births between the two dates get different answers.

Births from Li Chun until Chinese New Year are already the {name} by the year pillar but still the {previous} by the lunar year; on Li Chun day itself, compare the birth time.
